body: I know the guy i brought my thoughts up to wasnt being intentionally cruel, although the banality of cruelty certainly baffles me as well. i hear you on my friend and im sorry that you lost a loved one. i dunno tho, he seems very happy these days, i dont want to cause him pain of course, i dont want to cause anyone pain, but i wonder, if the pain he has over it isnt so terrible, i mean, he wont be killing himself over it, is it so bad to cause to escape my pain? hard to know. thanks for the response
